messages: maya: tiny mock here — compact stream header with token chip + two actions. attached. quick takes on wording and screen reader behavior? design-bot: uploaded image compact-stream-mini.png :framed_picture: sam: eng notes: throttle token updates (~1s), fix width to avoid layout shift. 'Pause' implies resumable; 'Interrupt' maps to abort. emily: copy rec: use 'Interrupt' as primary, 'Regenerate' secondary. token label: 'Tokens used: 1,234'. tooltip for SR: 'Interrupt generation — preserves last partial output.' liam: a11y nits: wrap streaming text in aria-live="polite" and throttle announcements. make token chip aria-hidden=true and expose a separate sr-only announcer that updates on completion or milestones. ensure contrast >=4.5:1. maya: UX question: on Regenerate keep last output visible or clear it? sam: keep it and show subtle overlay spinner labelled "Regenerating". less destructive. emily: I'll add i18n keys and the tooltip strings. liam: I'll draft small a11y QA steps: focus order, live region throttle, contrast, keyboard stop behavior. maya: decision: label = 'Interrupt'; visible token (debounced) + sr-only updates on completion/milestones; preserve partial output during regenerate. posting updated mock. :thumbsup: design-bot: uploaded image compact-stream-mini-v2.png :framed_picture: sam: will open PR with debounce + aria-live snippet. snip for review: 1,234 Tokens used: 1234 emily: copy landed in i18n branch. liam: QA checklist added to docs. maya: thanks all, closing this quick thread. reopen if any regressions.
